general.description:
This station is a base for all smugglers, pirates, corsairs and blockade runners in the Human Sphere.
It is of common knowledge, that almost every cargo can be traded there, albeit for a price that can greatly vary, and depends mostly on luck and random arrivals.
general.bar: Mean-looking Spacers, mostly Humans, with a few Rithai and K'Rinns and an occassional Sshaad
